strategies.reason: The public component has a canonical non-grid browser implementation and should converge to a generated or generic React facade while preserving the captured React API.

React provider ownership is framework-specific integration rather than canonical DOM rendering. Retain it until MFD-1415 determines whether a narrow integration adapter or an ADR-008 exception is required; historical existence alone is not sufficient for a permanent dedicated renderer.

nonComponentExports.name: useToast
nonComponentExports.reason: This is a React hook rather than a component renderer. Its compatibility remains part of the public baseline and ToastProvider migration work.

rules: Every public React component value export is classified exactly once.
Generated facade is the default target; temporary legacy status is not a permanent exception.
Dedicated-renderer status requires an active or retiring ADR-008 framework exception record.
Migration batches remain reversible and must preserve the MFD-1401 compatibility baseline unless a separate public migration is approved.
